title: Control Flow Practice 1
statement:
Module 2 (Control Flow) covers: attributes and global attributes, divs and spans, html entities, comments in html, links deep dive, images best practices. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 1: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Attributes and Global Attributes).
hints: Re-read the Attributes and Global Attributes lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
